notes.title: 🚀 Playtest Build 431 Patch 🚀
notes.content:
WarpedSpace Patch Notes

Audio & UI
Improved UI for Base Fabricator and Build Tool.

Equipment & Modules
Fixed bug causing expansion slots to only equip one module.
Cargo & Component slots are no longer draggable.
Fixed issue equipping Bio Fuel.

Fabricator & Research
Reworked Base Fabricator, now requires power.
Added Fabricator Arm.
Improved UI for fabricating medium items.
Updated Research Panel with a Category column.

Build & Construction
Removed ADS from Build Tool.
During placement Left Alt now toggles Rotate / Distance.
Added Space Dock to Build Tool Menu.

Missions & Progression
Updated Mission System, fixed bug handing out items prematurely.
Added ability to start/stop mission chains.
Added a new First Task.

Quality of Life Improvements
Improved Hanger Doors to not trap the players ship
Fixed various issues with Boost & Boost Fuel.
Ship exit now checks for obstructions to prevent clipping inside objects.
Tractor Beam now works on marked Space Rocks.
Fixed bug looting Selenium nodes (blank item) and Carbon nodes (not collecting).
Improved Base Management UI.

Respawn & Save System
Fixed major bug where repaired Space Docks didn't register as respawn points.
Improved respawn mechanics (prevents being stuck in a destroyed ship).
Added a new Regen Pod for respawning.
Updated Base Screen: Requires ship to be linked/unlinked.

This update brings many improvements to gameplay, UI, and overall stability
— thank you for your feedback and support! 🚀

notes.title: ❄️ Playtest Build 404 Patch ❄️
notes.content:
Warped Space Patch Notes

New Features
Added: Databank for in-depth data tracking.
Added: Eject function for quick exits.
Added: Dialog volume slider for customizable audio.
Added: ScanMode key bind for improved accessibility.
Added: A New Steam Achievement (details redacted).
Added: Category column to the Research Panel.

UI Updates
Updated: Notifications to the UI for enhanced player feedback.
Updated: Various UI improvements, including Craft UI and Tooltip descriptions staying within bounds.
Updated: Iconography, schematics, and procedural scattered object handling.
Updated: Ship Storage integration into the main panel.
Updated: Ship marker visibility and clarity.
Updated: Engine offline notifications with EVA exit prompts.
Updated: Equip ship modules and removed redundant code.

Gameplay Updates
Improved: Tool Canister Exchange for Repair Tool.
Improved: Placing a space dock for better usability.
Updated: Ship movement for pitch. yaw and roll at slow speeds.
Updated: Base Air leaks now only occur when the base is pressurized.
Updated: Tractorable space rocks now persist.

Bug Fixes
Fixed: "Take All" button functionality.
Fixed: Oxygen refill bug.

This update brings a host of improvements to gameplay, UI, and overall stability
— thank you for your feedback and support! 🚀

notes.title: Christmas Playtest Update
notes.content:
Dear Test Pilots,

As we continue to progress towards the Demo of WarpedSpace & Early Access,
your feedback has been invaluable in helping identify and resolve issues  and give feedback on current system, feel and game mechanics.

Thank you for your support as we move closer to delivering the ultimate 
Space Survival Game Experience with a fresh twist.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279142/5cc5b7df76b8a4e019e2e4cbd9b026fe9825ac71.png

Summary of Dev Log over the last 2 week:


Base Mechanics:
Air leaks with VFX/SFX, depressurization mechanics, and repairs with a tool (3-5 seconds per repair). 
Air leaks occur only after significant damage.
Base Hanger Improvements
Planter with growing mechanics for fruit.
Base light switch, manager interaction, and module tooltips.

Tools:
Repair tool updated to require consumables and functional UI.
Build tool schematic, base building tool, and panel for creating test build items.

Weapons & Tools:
Beam weapons/tools now accurately align with the crosshair.
Added ion gas, ion fuel metadata, and depleted state tracking for ion gas vents.

Persistence:
Placed objects retain their scan percentage and charge.
Starter base persistent loot and AI (Squid).

Miscellaneous Additions:
- Asteroid radar marker.
- Base fuel refinery foundation.
- Items requiring multiple fragments.

Gameplay:
Food consumption re-enabled.
Creatures prevented from eating bases unless discovered.
Ship outer panel slot interaction improved. 
New proximity-based sound effects for leaks.

Scanning & Reporting:
Ship scanners can now detect and report the depleted state of ion gas vents and other items.

Testing:
Added test derelict hanger and persistent AI squid for exploration.
